subject: Stepdown Plan: Eval Handoff, Commitment Triggers, and Billing Kickoff
messages:
From: Elena Guzman <elena.guzman@novacorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + billing expectations for NovaCorp eval

Marcus — thanks for the conversation yesterday. As discussed, NovaCorp is ready to start a 90-day technical evaluation with engineering and security teams. Before we kick off, procurement asked that we document the commercial handoff so there are no surprises on billing.

High-level asks from our side:
- Formal MAP with milestone dates for feature validation and production readiness
- Clear trigger that moves us from trial to paid ramp (when billing starts)
- PO template we can use (our procurement requires PO prior to invoicing)
- Payment terms: our standard is Net30 — is that supported?

Can you send a short plan (MAP + invoicing runway) and the PO template? I attached the draft MAP the NovaCorp champion prepared.

Thanks,
Elena Guzman
Director, Product Strategy | NovaCorp
Attachments: NovaCorp_MAP_v1.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Guzman <elena.guzman@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + billing expectations for NovaCorp eval

Elena — great to see this moving. Attached is a concise MAP and a suggested commercial runway that aligns with what we discussed. Summary below, happy to adjust: 

Suggested MAP (90-day eval)
1) Week 0: Access/security review complete (Redwood private connector vetted)
2) Week 2–4: Core integration + baseline perf tests (small dataset)
3) Week 6: Quality gate — prompt set pass rate >= 85% (mutually agreed tests)
4) Week 8–10: Scale ramp validation (concurrent sessions, KV cache behaviour)
5) Week 12: Executive review + sign-off

Commercial handoff (recommended)
- Billing kickoff: Option A (preferred): Billing begins on signed order/contract once the MAP's executive sign-off is captured (Week 12). First invoice prorated to the month of signature.
- Option B (pilot-first): Start invoicing at the start of the production ramp (Week 9) if NovaCorp prefers earlier activation; we can provide a 20% pilot credit to offset risk.

Pricing & commits
- Pilot pricing: $0.10/token equivalent for eval usage (metered), capped at $15k for the 90d period.
- Ramp commit: 3-month reservation at $50k/month (monthly invoicing) or annualized at a 15% discount if NovaCorp signs a 12-month commitment.

Payment terms & PO
- Standard Redwood term: Net30 on hosted accounts. For reserved/dedicated we typically place Net60 for initial enterprise trials unless a PO with Net30 is returned.
- For this deal: we can accommodate Net30 provided a PO is received before the first invoice is issued. If NovaCorp requires Net30 but cannot issue a PO until signature, we can do Net45 for the first two invoices and Net30 thereafter.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears. First invoice prorated to contract start date; invoices will include token breakdown and a short cost summary.

Attachments: SOW_draft_Redwood.docx, PO_template_NovaCorp.pdf

Next steps: please confirm which billing kickoff option you prefer and whether procurement can send a PO before signature. I can loop in Legal for a one-page amendment if needed.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference
From: Elena Guzman <elena.guzman@novacorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + billing expectations for NovaCorp eval

Marcus — thanks, that format helps. Procurement flagged two points: 1) Net30 is a hard constraint for our AP team, and 2) they need a PO before any invoice is processed. They asked if Redwood can: 

- Accept a PO on signature and issue invoices Net30 thereafter (we can produce the PO concurrent with signature)
- If Redwood needs earlier protection, can you confirm the mechanism (e.g., pilot credit or refundable deposit)

Also, can you confirm the minimum committed ramp volume that locks the 15% annual discount? We'll need that number for procurement clearance.

I'll share the PO template internally and get back to you by Friday.

Thanks,
Elena
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Guzman <elena.guzman@novacorp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + billing expectations for NovaCorp eval

Elena — quick follow-up from our side on the discount trigger and protections: 

Discount trigger details
- The 15% annual discount applies to a 12-month commitment with a committed monthly spend >= $50,000 ARR-equivalent (i.e., $50k/month committed). We can build stepped discounting for larger tiers.

Pilot protections (if a PO cannot be produced pre-signature)
- Option 1: Pilot credit — Redwood issues a credit equal to 20% of pilot charges (applied to first month of paid usage) if you start invoicing at ramp.
- Option 2: Refundable good-faith deposit — NovaCorp pays a one-time $10k deposit at signature (refundable/prorated against first invoices).

We prefer PO-on-signature + Net30 operationally. If procurement confirms they will issue the PO at signature, that solves the Net30 ask and avoids the deposit.

Let us know procurement's cadence. We'll hold the MAP kickoff until we align on the PO and billing kickoff date.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@novacorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Guzman <elena.guzman@novacorp.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + billing expectations for NovaCorp eval

Marcus / Karthik — thanks for the clear options. Procurement can produce a PO concurrent with signature (internal approval path is in flight). We will aim to have the PO signed and returned on signature day. Two clarifications: 

1) PO language: please confirm Redwood accepts a PO referencing the SOW and that invoices will be sent to ap@novacorp.com with Net30 payment terms.
2) Prorated first invoice: confirm Redwood will prorate the first invoice to the contract start date and include the pilot credit (if Option A used).

If Redwood confirms acceptance of the PO and Net30 invoicing under those terms, we can proceed to signature and target Week 12 executive review as the commercial handoff. Please return a redlined PO template if needed.

Regards,
NovaCorp Procurement
Attachments: PO_template_NovaCorp.pdf
